stem: In which sentence does the author use an analogy to express the significance of the night on the beach with Hallie?

options.label: F
options.text: As I pocketed the gritty change, Hallie reached in the bucket, pulled out the crab and gently released it.

options.label: G
options.text: Despite the experiential knowledge Hallie has gained on our annual trips to South Padre, a crab taught father and daughter a lesson neither of us has forgotten.

options.label: H
options.text: Not only had the crab led us leprechaun-style to a small pot of gold—well, contemporary silver coins—it had turned the tables and captured us in a special father-daughter moment.

options.label: J
options.text: The feisty crab had drawn its figurative line in the sand surrounded by coins.
